run_test_filtering: run the TestFilteringTest suite to validate gRPC pull request test filtering logic
test_individual_language_filters: test that changing a language source file triggers only that language's test suite
test_combined_language_filters: test that changing multiple language files triggers only the relevant test suites
test_platform_filter: test that changing platform-specific files triggers only that platform's test suite
test_whitelist: test that the whitelist dictionary does not match files that should trigger all tests
